name: WdWrapType
description: Specifies how to wrap text around a shape.

constants.name: wdWrapSquare
constants.description: Wraps text around the shape. Line continuation is on the opposite side of the shape.

constants.name: wdWrapTight
constants.description: Wraps text close to the shape.

constants.name: wdWrapNone
constants.description: Places shape in front of text. See also wdWrapFront.

constants.name: wdWrapTopBottom
constants.description: Places text above and below the shape.

constants.name: wdWrapFront
constants.description: Places shape in front of text. See also wdWrapNone.

constants.name: wdWrapInline
constants.description: Places shapes in line with text.
